w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Nino lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Eulogy, The Timeslot, The Network Note) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
firstContext: You settle into the cold ground. Sleep takes you.
🗣️ Wei to Greta, by the fire: "The granary wants food that WAITS — 0 of 2,000 kcal preserved. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The fresh stuff doesn't count."
🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Eulogy, The Timeslot, The Network Note) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.
🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Timeslot came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.

🚨 The Eulogy, The Timeslot, The Network Note is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Old Big." The Codex keeps it.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: Your Snare 1 tile east sits empty. You read the ground on the way in — no sign, no promise.

🌙 Raid — Emberhold came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1000 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🌪️ THE FINALE struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)

loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.
